title: LightAPI
summary: The UsdLux light API, built into every light type. Render-only: the parser reads no column of it. It is a component only so the compiled stage cache does not bypass a Stage whose render prims carry it.
producer_scope: Written by USD population when a RENDERING description is populated beside the physics description (as IsaacLab populates), which keeps render prims; the physics description alone leaves it out.
